title: Maternal-fetal type I interferon signaling drives TREM2 dysregulation and synaptic dysfunction in neurodevelopmental disorders
title_zh: 母体-胎儿Ⅰ型干扰素信号驱动TREM2失调与神经发育障碍中的突触功能障碍
abstract: Maternal infections during gestation cause perturbed neuroimmune interactions and increased risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in the offspring. Using a maternal immune activation model with polyinosinic:polycytidylic acid (poly(I:C)), we investigated how maternal infections reshape the progeny hippocampal landscape. Poly(I:C) increased maternal type I interferon (IFN-I), disrupting neuronal transcriptional trajectories and excitatory synapse homeostasis in juvenile offspring. Poly(I:C) offspring microglia exhibited reduced expression of triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2), a key regulator of synapse elimination and brain development, accompanied by impaired phagocytosis and suppressed IFN-I-responsive substate. Consistently, a blunted IFN-I signature was observed in postmortem tissues from schizophrenic patients. TREM2 deficiency was associated with aberrant maternal IFN-I and altered neuronal and microglial signatures in poly(I:C) offspring, highlighting its regulatory role in neurodevelopmental pathologies. Blocking maternal IFN-I signaling restored synaptic defects and TREM2 function, suggesting that monitoring IFN-I responses during pregnancy and targeting defective IFN-I cascades in the newborn may represent viable therapeutic approaches to mitigate neurodevelopmental dysfunctions.
abstract_zh: 孕期母体感染会扰乱神经免疫相互作用，增加后代神经发育障碍的风险。我们利用聚腺苷酸-聚胞苷酸（poly(I:C)）的母体免疫激活模型，研究母体感染如何重塑后代海马的景观。poly(I:C)导致母体Ⅰ型干扰素（IFN-I）升高，破坏神经元转录轨迹和幼年后代的兴奋性突触稳态。poly(I:C)后代的微胶质细胞表现出触发受体表达在髓系细胞2（TREM2）表达下降，TREM2是突触消除和大脑发育的关键调节因子，同时伴随吞噬功能受损和IFN-I响应亚状态抑制。与此一致，精神分裂症患者的尸检组织中观察到IFN-I信号减弱。TREM2缺失与异常的母体IFN-I以及poly(I:C)后代的神经元和微胶质细胞特征改变相关，突显其在神经发育病理中的调控作用。阻断母体IFN-I信号可恢复突触缺陷和TREM2功能，提示在孕期监测IFN-I反应并针对新生儿的IFN-I通路缺陷可能是缓解神经发育功能障碍的可行治疗策略。
